SUMMARY...A developing line of storms may produce damaging wind
gusts through the afternoon. Watch issuance is possible.

DISCUSSION...Latest radar shows a broken line of storms developing
along a cold front moving through central Oklahoma. Modest
instability exists ahead of the front with MLCAPE values around
500-1000 J/kg. Deep layer shear of 35-45 kt will support organized
storms capable of producing damaging gusts to 60 mph.
